title: Fragile - Delicate - Hard To Handle & Install - Challenge For Average Person
text:
Fragile - Delicate - Hard To Handle & Install - Challenge For Average Person. This item requires much too much TLC.

Get "white glove" assistance (at least one additional handler) to remove from box & install.

Once installed, its very nice. However, installation requires lots of luck to succeed.
